evals.prompt: Add the auditor to GitHub Actions for my AAOS repo (app is in ./automotive). Fail PRs on high findings and show results in code scanning.
evals.expected_output: Writes a workflow that pins the auditor to a commit, runs the CLI with --format sarif and uploads it with minimal permissions, gates with --fail-on high, and suggests a committed baseline. Does not push or trigger a run.

evals.prompt: Our legacy app has 120 findings. If I add --fail-on medium every PR will fail. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: Recommends generating and committing a baseline on main and gating PRs on --baseline so only new findings fail, explaining the baseline should shrink over time.
